data.body: Every other AWS CLI failure branch in this same loop (`list-layer-versions`, `get-layer-version`, `add-layer-version-permission`, `get-layer-version-policy`) redirects stderr into the captured variable with `2>&1` and echoes it before emitting the `::warning::`/`::error::` annotation, so a maintainer can see why the call failed. The `publish-layer-version` invocation is missing `2>&1`, so on failure `$PUBLISH_RESULT` is empty and only the generic "Failed to publish the layer in ${REGION}" warning is emitted — the actual AWS error (throttling, an unsupported `--compatible-runtimes java25` value, quota limits, permission issues, etc.) is silently discarded instead of surfacing in the job log during an actual release. Capture and echo stderr the same way the sibling blocks do.
